scripts.predev: npm run db:up && npm run contracts:generate && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.prebuild: npm run contracts:generate && npm run db:generate
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @harvest/shared && npm run build --workspace @harvest/api && npm run build --workspace @harvest/website
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @harvest/api && npm run lint --workspace @harvest/website
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @harvest/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @harvest/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @harvest/website
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @harvest/api && npm run test --workspace @harvest/website
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
